ownerPointer.description: Generic IL2CPP statics owner pointer, used by a large number of methods; the actual substitution array is reached through managed/static memory and offset 0xF560

xorWord.description: Shared word used by wrapper and getter. The writer's XOR RIP instruction at 0xBB160A3 is confirmed separately from original disassembly and outside the MOV/LEA scanner.

nextProof.conditionalRoundTripInvariant: For every byte position i in [0..3] and x in [0..255], read_page_i[write_page_i[x]] == x; writer and reader additionally require the same runtime XOR word.

limitations: These counts are raw MOV/LEA RIP-relative byte-pattern candidates from the bounded xref scanner, not an exhaustive disassembly of aligned code and not unique Gadget-specific references.
The writer's RIP-relative XOR opcode is excluded from the MOV/LEA xref scanner; no candidate MOV/LEA write was found, but indirect/other writes were not ruled out.
Unmapped file-backed reads are not proof of zero runtime values or runtime absence; they mean the exact bytes are not available from a file-backed PE section at those RVAs.
The generic static owner pointer is widely shared, making naive full xref traversal poor evidence of which method populates the Gadget wrapper's +0xF560 storage.
No runtime lookup-table bytes or evidence of their relationship were recovered; no claims about reversible runtime IDs, scene tags, or server reward distributions follow.
